summary: Kaggle code competition on smart-building control with a NeurIPS 2026 workshop paper track. Run as notebooks with up to 9 hours and no internet.
eligibility: Kaggle users aged 18+ worldwide except Crimea, DNR, LNR, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and sanctioned persons. Teams of up to 5.
title: Smart Buildings Competition 2026 (Kaggle)
deadlineLabel: Final submissions and papers (15 Jan 2027 23:59 UTC)

prize.description: US$40,000: US$25,000 across eight leaderboard places (US$5,750 down to US$2,500) and US$15,000 paper track.

notes: Poster paper deadline 13 Nov 2026; last day to join teams 3 Jan 2027.
